queryOutcomes: Separate English and Marathi discovery queries were performed. Both identified first-party Maharashtra land-record/BhuNaksha material. English discovery also identified Government of India Census village identity evidence. Search did not expose a parcel JSON/API response.
requestOutcomes: The official BhuNaksha root timed out on a TLS-verified bounded curl request. The official services and village-master pages were available through indexed first-party evidence, but neither exposed a bounded parcel ID+geometry response. No parcel API request was sent because viewer JavaScript/configuration could not be retrieved.

qualification.reason: An official state land-record custodian, Waladgaon village identity, and public map lead were verified, but bounded anonymous parcel ID+geometry access was unavailable during this attempt; research is complete but source admission is not justified.

uncertainty: Direct BhuNaksha access was unavailable by timeout, so current JavaScript/configuration, API routes, field schema, CRS, and citywide coverage remain unverified. The official service descriptions do not establish that every Waladgaon parcel is publicly downloadable.
